name: Default
shortDescription: Tabby terminal served as a web app with OAuth login, per-user config sync and a MariaDB database.

alerts.message: Login needs at least one OAuth provider. Fill the GitHub, GitLab, Google, Microsoft or OIDC key and secret variables and redeploy; the callback URL is https://<your-domain>/api/1/auth/social/complete/<provider>/ (github, gitlab, google-oauth2, microsoft-graph or oidc). Every account that can sign in with a configured provider gets its own Tabby Web account, so use an OIDC provider you control to limit who can log in.
SSH and Telnet connections go through a separate tabby-connection-gateway; enter its address and token in the Tabby settings after logging in.
